messages:
sophie: quick note — starting quarterly least-privilege pass focused on KMS bindings and admin-like roles. scope: prod + staging, target inactive principals >120d. dry-run first.
drew: thanks. can we exclude cert-rotation principals and HSM keys? last time certs broke.
sophie: yes — exclusion list maintained in runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/least-priv-q1.
ram: for KMS, I'll run a usage join: `gcloud logging read "resource.type=kms_key AND protoPayload.methodName:(\"Encrypt\" OR \"Decrypt\" OR \"AsymmetricSign\")" --limit 1000` and then map principals.
ella: policy for auto-revoke? propose: last_use>365d AND deploy_count==0 => auto-queue revoke after 7d notice. others -> ticket.
sophie: agreed. add temp-grant TTL 30d for auto-only.
drew: rollback: snapshot terraform state, create revert PRs, and include a 'regrant token' (audit id) for each revocation.
ticket-bot: [jira] SEC-4124 created: 'Q1 least-priv sweep - ownerless KMS & admin prune' assigned to @ella.
sec-bot: [audit] ownermap exported to s3://redwood-audit/2999001234/ownermap.csv by sophie at 2026-03-21T17:25:10Z.
ram: scanner alert: legacy endpoint /api/v0/roles/assign still present on svc-legacy, exclude until SEC-4130 fixed.
sophie: exclude svc-legacy. if any grant path can be abused, mark high-sev and pause on that service.
ella: splitting into micro-batches: batch-1 low-risk (ro/admins with no write perms), batch-2 infra engineers (notify infra), batch-3 manual tickets. running dry-run now, will post diff to ticket.
drew: add smoke tests that exercise role-specific flows and run for 30m post-change. if >1 critical failure -> revert and page sec-oncall.
sophie: I'll post the prod canary window and ping #eng-oncall tomorrow. final: do not auto-touch HSM-backed keys or principals linked to cert rotation. thanks everyone.
